D: Samantha's family forgets her 16th birthday because of her sister's wedding.
P: Serve dessert at the very end, when Jake has the birthday cake waiting.
S: Cream and egg ham tartlets, plus cucumber rounds topped with smoked salmon
Smoked salmon on cucumber rounds and mini quiches (shortcrust cases, egg, cream, ham and chives baked at 180C for 15 minutes).
Shermer High dance cinnamon pretzel bites
the geek in the gym at the school dance

Soft pretzel bites dipped in a bicarb bath and baked deep brown, rolled in butter and cinnamon sugar, with a warm salted caramel dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Roll into ropes, cut into 3cm bites and dip in 2 litres boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss in 50g melted butter, then 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Warm 150ml store-bought caramel sauce with a pinch of salt for dipping.
Golden pork dumplings steamed in the pan, soy and black vinegar dip
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until the bottoms crisp, a splash of water and a lid for 4 minutes, soy and black vinegar dip.
M: the house is full of grandparents

Beef chuck braised for hours with onion, carrot and stock until it falls apart, with buttery potatoes and a rich gravy from the pot. Season a 1.5kg chuck roast and brown it all over in a heavy pot. Add 2 quartered onions, 4 carrots in chunks and 3 garlic cloves, then 750ml beef stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste, thyme and bay. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Lift out the meat and veg and thicken the liquid with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water.
Chicken thighs braised with mushrooms, thyme, white wine and cream, rice pilaf
Chicken thighs browned, braised with white wine, mushrooms, thyme and a splash of cream for 35 minutes. Rice pilaf.
W: Two-layer butter cake with strawberry buttercream and sixteen candles
Two layers of vanilla butter cake baked at 170C for 30 minutes, filled and covered in pink strawberry buttercream, exactly sixteen candles.
K: Pineapple, orange, cranberry and passionfruit punch topped with lemonade, no alcohol

Pineapple, orange and cranberry juice with passionfruit, lime and fizzy lemonade, poured over ice with floating orange slices and frozen berries. In a big punch bowl, mix 500ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice, 300ml cranberry juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Chill. Just before serving, add 1 litre cold lemonade, plenty of ice, 1 sliced orange and 150g frozen mixed berries. Ladle into cups.

s.note: Cream and egg ham tartlets, plus cucumber rounds topped with smoked salmon
s.how: Line a 12-hole tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream, add 80g diced ham and chives, fill and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Top thick cucumber rounds with 150g smoked salmon.

s.note: Golden pork dumplings steamed in the pan, soy and black vinegar dip
s.how: Fry 24 frozen pork dumplings flat side down in a little oil until golden. Add 100ml water, cover and steam 4 minutes. Uncover and crisp again. Mix soy and black vinegar with sliced spring onion to dip.

m.note: Chicken thighs braised with mushrooms, thyme, white wine and cream, rice pilaf
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs. Add 250g mushrooms, thyme and 200ml white wine and braise 35 minutes, then stir in 100ml cream. Cook 300g long grain rice with a knob of butter and 600ml stock for pilaf.

w.note: Two-layer butter cake with strawberry buttercream and sixteen candles
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Blitz 150g strawberries and beat into 250g butter with 450g icing sugar. Fill, cover and add exactly sixteen candles.

d.note: Pineapple, orange, cranberry and passionfruit punch topped with lemonade, no alcohol
d.how: In a big punch bowl, mix 500ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice, 300ml cranberry juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Chill. Just before serving, add 1 litre cold lemonade, plenty of ice, 1 sliced orange and 150g frozen mixed berries. Ladle into cups.
